entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: info expects 1 or 2 arguments, got %d
entries.rationale: The PromQL parser pins info() arity via Variadic:1 over a two-vector ArgTypes signature, so a call with zero or three-plus arguments is rejected at parse time and never reaches lowering.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: info() base is not a known histogram-valued shape: %v
entries.rationale: isExpHistogramValuedShape already proves c.Args[0] histogram-valued; lowerInfo reuses lowerExpHistogramValuedShape for that same expression, mirroring lowerExpHistogramDroppingAggregation's identical guard

guard: past returning if b, ok := infoArgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp(c.Args[0], s, ctx); ok
